Plenty of EMPTY space between sprites is mandatory. No clipped appendages, no pedestal, no ground, no cast shadow, no aura or glow outside the body, no particles, no floating detached items, no text, labels, borders or background. All anatomical features must attach physically to the body; any crown/halo is a connected anatomical ornament. If a creature floats, show its complete underside clearly.
